# Getting help with NetSpeedTray

- **A question, or "how do I...?"** - ask in [Q&A](https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/discussions/categories/q-a). The [FAQ](../README.md#faq) answers the common ones.
- **Something's broken** - open a [bug report](https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) and attach a support bundle (the **Export support bundle** button at the bottom of Settings; usernames, paths, IPs and adapter names are stripped from it).
- **An idea** - start in [Ideas](https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/discussions/categories/ideas), or use the [feature request form](https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) for a concrete request.
- **A translation fix** - the [translation thread](https://github.com/erez-c137/NetSpeedTray/issues/364), or see [TRANSLATORS.md](../TRANSLATORS.md).
- **Deploying to many PCs** - [DEPLOYING.md](../DEPLOYING.md).
